description:
The WhatsApp numbers your API key can see, oldest first. Use it to find
a number id, then pass that id to the other routes. Each number carries
`capabilities`, which says what it can send. Archived numbers are left
out.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit it on the first request and pass it back unchanged.

name: listWhatsappNumbers
